verdict.rationale: TruffleHog supports custom detectors defined via regex (with optional webhook verification) that can be loaded via a config file and the --include-detectors flag, which can be reused across scans/repos (trufflehog-docs-6, trufflehog-docs-27, trufflehog-docs-14, trufflehog-docs-7). This covers a narrow secrets-detection use case but is not a general SAST rule syntax, and there's no documented mechanism for packaging/sharing rule sets as reusable artifacts across teams or repos beyond passing the same config file. Missing for 10: a simple declarative rule DSL beyond raw regex, built-in rule-sharing/registry across repositories, and independent evidence of teams using custom detectors at scale.
